name: BACH_0174
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 frozen section with positive margins [F9]; 2/5 similar cases are InSitu.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0% [F1] | Single dominant class |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (90% coverage) | Single class at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 64% OOD [F6] | Typical image, 12/12 regions |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree | Independent models match top class |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Invasive (60%), 2/5 InSitu [F5] | Mixed; InSitu contrast 89% similar |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (+0.52) [F2]; 0/20 spot-checked (unreliable) · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Low (+0.44) [F3]; differs from InSitu BACH_0241 · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · High (-0.38) opposes invasion [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · High (+0.28) supports invasion (19/20 spot-checked) · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 5, 8, 9) · context · 73% tumor nuclei (97th percentile); 92nd-percentile TIL proximity [F7, F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions beats random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.001 vs random, CI -0.009–0.006); normal_lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions are florid InSitu, matching similar cases BACH_0241 (89%) and BACH_0117 (87%).
- Frozen-section edge signal reflects InSitu ducts rather than invasion at all four margins.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 5, 8, 9**: Verify stromal invasion versus InSitu in high-risk, tumor-dense areas.
2. **Regions 3, 10, 11**: Check whether tubules and duct-confined cells are InSitu or invasive.
3. **Regions 0–3, 4, 7, 8–11**: Inspect all four edges for true margin involvement.
